reason: The signed date and paying the balance only after I check the work are exactly what I want, but they are new in Kochi, so there are no Google reviews and nobody in my WhatsApp groups has used them. I'll ask for the free site visit, but I won't pay 30% to be one of their first test houses.
objection: Nobody I know has seen their crew finish a job here. ₹2,000 a day is small comfort if my house sits half-painted with the furniture pushed around for weeks. And my bedroom wall bubbled from damp. Will they fix the dampness or just paint over it and leave me to argue about the guarantee later?
would_change_my_mind: Visiting a finished Turbolux home in Kochi and talking to the owner, or a neighbour or someone in my WhatsApp group saying they finished on the signed date.
